content.title: Ukraine's President Urges US and Musk to Lift Starlink Restrictions
content.caption: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky urges the US and SpaceX to lift restrictions on Starlink satellite internet service, which is crucial for Ukraine's defense and energy infrastructure.

slides.heading: Ukraine's President Urges US and Musk to Lift Starlink Restrictions
slides.text: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky urges the US and SpaceX to lift restrictions on Starlink satellite internet service, which is crucial for Ukraine's defense and energy infrastructure.

slides.heading: Ukraine's Defense and Energy Infrastructure
slides.text: Ukraine's Starlink satellite internet service is crucial for its defense and energy infrastructure, but restrictions are still in place, making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

slides.heading: Why the Restrictions are Still in Place
slides.text: Zelensky has asked officials to work closely with the US government and SpaceX to lift restrictions on Starlink, which is crucial for Ukraine's defense and energy infrastructure.
